verbatim_quote.original: When the joined text exceeds the cap, cut it and append an explicit note stating the dropped character count, in the same spirit as the brain bridge's `[...truncated at N chars]` markers.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: When the joined text exceeds the cap, cut it and append an explicit note stating the dropped character count, in the same spirit as the brain bridge's `[...truncated at N chars]` markers.

extracted_decision.summary: Truncate oversized joined transcript text and append an explicit marker stating the dropped character count.
extracted_decision.rationale: The model must never be asked to extract from a silently partial transcript.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Marker makes truncation visible but its wording can be read as retained size rather than dropped size
